audit_findings.title: Unconsolidated affiliates may be counted twice
audit_findings.magnitude: $2.889 billion bridge addition; $386 million of 2025 equity earnings and $397 million of distributions; bridge addition equals $4.55 per share and 5.6% of base equity value
audit_findings.mechanism: Affiliate earnings or distributions may enter OE while the affiliates' carrying value is also added through stakes_net in the equity bridge.
audit_findings.evidence: Our operating cash flows are derived partially from cash distributions we receive from our unconsolidated affiliates.
audit_findings.explanation: The filing demonstrates that affiliate economics enter consolidated earnings and cash flow, but the supplied record does not demonstrate whether they were purged from OE. Therefore double counting remains an unresolved possibility, not a demonstrated error. The $4.55-per-share bridge addition is large enough to move the $95.55 bull value below the $94.97 market price if duplicated.
audit_findings.action: Trace each 2025 equity-method earnings and distribution line through OE; rerun with either affiliate economics excluded from OE or the corresponding stake value removed from the bridge.

audit_findings.title: Forecast growth may omit the capital required to produce it
audit_findings.magnitude: Filed 2026 capital-expenditure forecast of $2.7-$3.2 billion; using the supplied 6.9% RONTA, computed reinvestment is approximately $2.258 billion for 5% growth and $3.613 billion for 8% growth on the $3.1162 billion anchor
audit_findings.mechanism: Growth raises forecast OE and terminal value without an explicit deduction for the incremental capital or affiliate contributions required to create that growth.
audit_findings.evidence: We expect total capital expenditures of $2.7 - $3.2 billion in 2026.
audit_findings.explanation: The scenario math visibly grants 5% and 8% growth without a separate reinvestment charge. Whether this is a demonstrated valuation error depends on whether forecast OE already includes all growth capital, which the record does not establish. The reinvestment implied by the supplied RONTA is comparable to or greater than total forecast capital spending and is reasonably capable of changing the conclusion.
audit_findings.action: Separate maintenance from growth capital and affiliate contributions, establish attainable incremental returns, and rerun each growth scenario with the required reinvestment deducted from forecast OE.

audit_findings.title: Maintenance capital may be understated for an aging asset base
audit_findings.mechanism: An understated maintenance-capex deduction inflates sustainable OE, every forecast year and terminal value.
audit_findings.evidence: Many of our assets have been in service for several decades.
audit_findings.explanation: The filing establishes that many assets have operated for decades and that aging can increase maintenance and remediation expenditures, but it does not demonstrate that the valuation's maintenance allowance is deficient or quantify any shortfall. Because terminal value is 47.7%-52.6% of operating value, a recurring shortfall could matter, but present materiality cannot be established.
audit_findings.action: Reconcile maintenance capex over a full asset cycle to integrity management, remediation, replacements and recurring affiliate sustaining contributions, then rerun for any evidenced recurring shortfall.

audit_findings.title: Unrecognized retirement obligations may sit ahead of common equity
audit_findings.mechanism: The present value of abandonment, removal and remediation obligations would reduce the equity bridge or require future OE/capital deductions before common equity receives value.
audit_findings.evidence: We are not able to estimate reasonably the fair value of the asset retirement obligations for portions of our assets, primarily certain pipeline assets, because the settlement dates are indeterminable given our expected continued use of the assets with proper maintenance.
audit_findings.explanation: The filing demonstrates that legal retirement obligations exist for which fair value cannot be reasonably estimated because settlement dates are indeterminable. It does not establish their amount or timing. This is an existing omitted economic claim rather than merely a future operating risk, but the record cannot determine whether its present value is material.
audit_findings.action: Develop asset-class abandonment scenarios with probability, timing, salvage and remediation costs; discount them consistently with the valuation and deduct any material present value or reserve.

audit_findings.title: The 2025 anchor may retain a nonrecurring debt-extinguishment gain
audit_findings.magnitude: $106 million pretax, equal to 3.4% of the $3.1162 billion anchor
audit_findings.mechanism: If retained in 2025 OE, the financing gain increases the anchor and is multiplied through forecast OE and terminal value.
audit_findings.evidence: In connection with these open market repurchases, we recognized $ 106 million of net gains on extinguishment of debt which is included in other income, net in our Consolidated Statement of Income for the year ended December 31, 2025.
audit_findings.explanation: The $106 million one-time gain is demonstrated, but its inclusion in OE is not: the supplied record confirms an interest-income purge without showing a debt-gain purge. Its scale is material because the bull value exceeds the $94.97 market price by only $0.58 per share, while capitalizing even the after-tax portion of this gain could exceed that margin.
audit_findings.action: Trace other income, net into the 2025 OE workpaper; remove the $106 million pretax gain and its actual tax effect while retaining recurring interest expense, then rerun all scenarios.

audit_findings.title: Exceptional gains may contaminate the historical growth signal
audit_findings.magnitude: $779 million 2023 settlement gain, or $633 million net of $146 million third-party fractionation costs, equal to 30.7% of reported 2023 OE; $227 million 2024 divestiture gain equals 8.5% of reported 2024 OE
audit_findings.mechanism: Exceptional gains can inflate historical OE growth and thereby support overly high base and bull growth assumptions, although the latest-year anchor cap prevents their direct inclusion in the $3.1162 billion anchor.
audit_findings.evidence: We applied the $ 830 million received to our outstanding insurance receivable at December 31, 2022, of $ 51 million, and recorded an operational gain for the remaining $ 779 million in other operating income, net, within the Consolidated Statement of Income for the year ended December 31, 2023.
audit_findings.explanation: The exceptional gains are demonstrated, but the record does not show whether the OE series already removed them or how much they influenced the selected 5% and 8% growth rates. The anchor is the latest actual rather than the higher $4.445 billion trend, limiting direct impact; any remaining effect is through growth judgment, whose materiality cannot be established from the record.
audit_findings.action: Trace and normalize the 2023 Medford amount, the 2024 pipeline-sale gain and other exceptional proceeds year by year; recompute the trend and reconsider growth scenarios using only normalized OE.

audit_findings.title: Unidentified D&A is conservatively left in owner earnings
audit_findings.magnitude: Approximately $11.8 million computed FY2017 residual, representing 2.9% of filed FY2017 D&A and 0.38% of the $3.1162 billion 2025 anchor
audit_findings.mechanism: Any eligible residual D&A left expensed understates historical OE and could affect the historical trend, but it does not increase the latest-year anchor.
audit_findings.evidence: identified eligible D&A is below the filed composite; residual is conservatively left as an expense, not added back: FY2017 $394.4m (97.1% of filed D&A)
audit_findings.explanation: The treatment is conservative rather than value-inflating. The specifically identified FY2017 residual is approximately $11.8 million, is remote from the 2025 anchor year and is only 0.38% of the current anchor. Because the valuation caps the anchor at the latest actual below trend, this isolated residual is not reasonably capable of changing the valuation conclusion.
audit_findings.action: Classify the residual from filed disclosures; rerun only if evidence identifies materially larger eligible recurring residuals in the latest years.
